items.title: Hackers Could Execute Commands on WordPress, Email and Print Servers Through Upload2Shell Flaw
items.description: A flaw in Ghostscript let researchers run commands on WordPress, Roundcube webmail, and Linux print servers through routine file processing. The vulnerability, dubbed Upload2Shell and tracked as CVE-2026-125396, affects upstream Ghostscript releases before 10.08.0.
